title: Genesis 4:9 — “Am I my brother’s keeper?” = Am I the shepherd’s shepherd?
summary: Genesis 4:9 in English and Hebrew: the LORD asks Cain where Abel is, and Cain answers “Am I my brother’s keeper?” The slide then asks “Am I the shepherd’s shepherd?” in olive, tying Cain’s question to Abel being a shepherd.

text.text: 9 And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
9 ויאמר יהוה אל קין אי הבל אחיך ויאמר לא ידעתי השמר אחי אנכי׃

uncertain: The LORD in English and יהוה in Hebrew have individually coloured letters (decorative: red L/yod, orange R/vav), meaning not explained on this slide.
